title: The Wood God Guard and Zhen Qing's end
summary: Inside the Realm of Ten Thousand Trees, Mu Chen's Thunder Summoning Art clashes with Xia Hou's Nine Stars Piercing the Sun, while Luo Li finds the barrier's central meridian and blocks it with a divine artifact. Zhen Qing then turns on his ally and drains Xia Hou dry, and the Holy Son dies as 'nourishment' for the awakening Wood God Guard, whose strength approaches Sovereign level. Zhen Qing boasts that the drained teams, including Mu Fengyang, are now puppets, but Mu Chen works out that their divine souls are only locked by a seal that has to keep drawing power. Mu Chen takes a near-Sovereign blow, comprehends the Wood God Seal and reverses it, freeing everyone. The freed Phoenix and Desolate fighters turn on Zhen Qing, who self-destructs to take them with him, and the teams flee the hall. Luo Li takes the Wood God Guard away with them.
